name: STRYCHNINUM PURUM
key_symptoms: Constant retching. Violent vomiting. Nausea of pregnancy.
Restless. Over-irritability. Full and bursting headache, with heat in eyes. Vertigo, with roaring in ears. Jerking of head forwards. Scalp sore. Itching of scalp and nape.
Spasm of muscles about larynx. Excessive dyspnśa. Sharp, contractive pains in muscles of chest. Persistent cough, recurring after influenza.

Limbs stiff. Rheumatism with stiff joints. Violent jerking, twitching, and trembling. Tetanic convulsions and opisthotonos; spasms provoked by slightest touch and attempt to move. Shocks in the muscles. Cramp-like pains.
Rigitidy of cervical muscles. Sharp pain in nape and down spine. Back stiff; violent jerks in spinal column. Icy sensation down spine.

gi_symptoms: Constant retching. Violent vomiting. Nausea of pregnancy.
urinary_symptoms: Desire for coitus (Canth; Camph; Fl ac; Lach; Phos; Plat). Any touch on body excites a voluptuous sensation.
musculoskeletal_symptoms: Limbs stiff. Rheumatism with stiff joints. Violent jerking, twitching, and trembling. Tetanic convulsions and opisthotonos; spasms provoked by slightest touch and attempt to move. Shocks in the muscles. Cramp-like pains.
skin_symptoms: Itching of whole body, especially nose. Icy sensation down the spine.
fever_symptoms: Cold chills down spine. Perspiration in a stream down head and chest. Lower extremities cold.
